ChannelExecution.description: Whether a retrieval channel was asked for, and whether it actually ran.

executed.description: True only if runtime evidence shows the channel ran and returned a result set (possibly empty).
executed.title: Executed

ChannelExecution.title: ChannelExecution

CriticalityLevel.description:
Operational criticality of the task outcome.
Higher criticality → stricter quality threshold, slower escalation path allowed.
CriticalityLevel.title: CriticalityLevel

message.description: Human-readable; never contains stack traces, paths or config.
message.title: Message

rung.description: Ladder rung id, e.g. expanded_retrieval, graph_augmentation, max_capability. The ladder length is configurable.
rung.title: Rung

exhausted.description: True if every allowed escalation failed.
exhausted.title: Exhausted

research_evidence.description: True only if the answer came from a real model run. Always false for mock output. Does NOT mean the trace belongs to any benchmark.
research_evidence.title: Research Evidence

answer.description: Raw model output for this attempt (untrusted text).
answer.title: Answer

executed.description: True only if runtime evidence shows the channel ran and returned a result set (possibly empty).
executed.title: Executed

MachineInfo.description: The machine that PRODUCED the metrics (not necessarily the one serving).
MachineInfo.title: MachineInfo

Metric.description:
A single number with its unit and provenance.

``value`` is ``null`` when the quantity was not obtained; then
``provenance`` is ``null`` and ``method`` is ``"not_available"``.

method.description: Machine-readable method id, e.g. perf_counter, provider_usage, nvml_power_sample, tdp_proxy, pricing_table, grid_intensity, weighted_mean, sum, not_available. Vocabulary: docs/API_CONTRACT.md §5.
method.title: Method

provenance.description: Provenance tier; null exactly when value is null.

value.description: The number, or null if it was not obtained (never a placeholder).
value.title: Value

Metric.title: Metric

answer.description: Final answer, or the INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE refusal text.
answer.title: Answer

answer_attempt_index.description: Attempt whose answer is returned; null on refusal.
answer_attempt_index.title: Answer Attempt Index

PipelineTrace.description: The full trace of one query through the EIH pipeline.

classification.description: null if the system does not classify (A, B).

PipelineTrace.title: PipelineTrace

executed.description: True only if runtime evidence shows the channel ran and returned a result set (possibly empty).
executed.title: Executed

ResourceMetrics.description:
Resource accounting for one attempt, or totals for the whole trace.

Totals inherit the weakest tier of their components (MEASURED is
strongest); see docs/API_CONTRACT.md §5.
ResourceMetrics.title: ResourceMetrics

RetrievalMode.description: Primary retrieval mode — drives which indices are queried.
RetrievalMode.title: RetrievalMode

RetrievalTrace.description: Retrieval for one attempt. All parameters describe what EXECUTED.

requested_strategy.description: Strategy the policy or escalation asked for.
requested_strategy.title: Requested Strategy

strategy_fallback.description: True if the executed strategy is not the requested one.
strategy_fallback.title: Strategy Fallback

strategy_name.description: Strategy that actually executed. Differs from requested_strategy when the retriever fell back (see strategy_fallback).
strategy_name.title: Strategy Name

RetrievalTrace.title: RetrievalTrace

RetrievedChunkTrace.description:
One retrieved chunk with a file:line citation.

``content`` is UNTRUSTED repository text. Clients must render it as plain
text (never HTML/Markdown with live links) and must never treat it as
instructions. See docs/API_CONTRACT.md §6.

channel.description: Which retrieval channel produced this chunk.
channel.title: Channel

citation.description: '<repository>:<file_path>:<start_line>-<end_line>'; line part omitted when lines are unknown.
citation.title: Citation

RetrievedChunkTrace.title: RetrievedChunkTrace

provenance.description: Tier of the score; null exactly when score is null.

SystemId.description: Ablation ladder position (CLAUDE.md, 'What this project is').
SystemId.title: SystemId

TaskType.description:
Fine-grained task type within an SDLC stage.
Initial supported set (Phase-0 definition); extend in Phase-1.
TaskType.title: TaskType

repository.description: Restrict retrieval to one ingested repository (owner/name).
repository.title: Repository

passed.description: null when the gate did not execute.
passed.title: Passed

info.description: Frozen v1 contract between the EIH research pipeline and the web platform. See docs/API_CONTRACT.md.
info.title: EIH Pipeline Trace API

post.summary: Run one query and return the full pipeline trace

200.description: Server-Sent Events. Each event's `event:` field equals the JSON `event` discriminator; `data:` is one TraceEvent.

post.summary: Run one query and stream trace events as they happen
